name: io.github.ChristophEnglisch/hetzner-model-context-protocol
description: Manage Hetzner Cloud servers, SSH keys, firewalls and volumes through the Hetzner Cloud API.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token of the Hetzner Cloud project (each token belongs to exactly one project). HCLOUD_TOKEN is accepted as an alias; set only one of them.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hetzner Cloud API base URL; https is required, http only for localhost. The token is sent to this host.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_PROJECT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name of the project in log lines (a-z, 0-9, '-', max 32)

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: If true, only read-only tools are registered

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated enabled toolsets (core, info, actions, ssh_keys, firewalls, storage) or all

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_LABEL_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Changes are limited to resources carrying all of these labels, comma-separated key=value; empty means no restriction

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_IAC_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Handling of resources with an infrastructure-as-code label: off, warn or block

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_IAC_LABELS
environmentVariables.description: Labels that mark a resource as managed by infrastructure code, comma-separated key=value, any one matches

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION
environmentVariables.description: If true, destructive and cost-incurring tools require confirm=true

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_ALLOW_COSTS
environmentVariables.description: If false, tools that can start or raise recurring costs are not registered

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_MAX_MONTHLY_COST
environmentVariables.description: Reject a single call whose added net monthly cost is above this amount, in the currency of the Hetzner pricing endpoint; empty means no limit

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_FIREWALL_GUARD_PORTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated TCP ports (at most 10) covered by the firewall lock-out warning

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout per request in milliseconds (1000 to 300000)

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_MCP_ACTION_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a tool waits for Hetzner actions in milliseconds (0 to 600000, 0 = never wait)
